questions.prompt: Which continue belongs in the big blind against a button open?
questions.explanation: AJs is a clear defend. Trash and folding aces are not.

questions.prompt: Small blind versus a hijack open with JTo at 100bb. The leak is…

choices.text: Flatting and playing a dominated hand out of position
Noticing that you are out of position

questions.explanation: JTo does not flat well from the small blind against a solid open.

questions.prompt: The big blind is not 'defending any two cards' because…

choices.text: Calls are illegal from the big blind
Even with a discount, the worst hands lose more than the pot offers
The button is forced to fold if the big blind calls

questions.explanation: Pot odds widen the defend. They do not make 72o profitable against a real open.

questions.prompt: Button min-raises, big blind holds KK. What do you do?

choices.text: Call only, so you never raise kings

questions.explanation: Kings 3-bet a steal. Slow-playing them from the big blind lets the button realize equity.
